address: 77/4 Klang Mueang Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Khon Kaen, Khon Kaen, 40000, Thailand
bio: This grilled pork spot is among the most popular street places in Khon Kaen, and its grilled pork neck with rice is the reason why. The tender, sweet and salty marinated meat perfectly matches the accompanying spicy tamarind sauce. Also recommended are the spicy salad and soup....
